# Dr Oracle

> Dr Oracle provides privacy-focused web analytics and monitoring solutions as a modern alternative to traditional analytics platforms.

Dr Oracle integrates Plausible Analytics, a lightweight and privacy-friendly analytics platform that respects user privacy while providing essential website insights. The platform emphasizes open-source principles and offers a compelling alternative to Google Analytics.

## Key Topics

- Plausible Analytics
- Web Analytics
- Privacy-Friendly
- Google Analytics Alternative
- Lightweight
- Open-Source
- Data Privacy
- Website Monitoring
- User Tracking
- Analytics Dashboard

## Analytics Platform

- [Plausible · Web Analytics](https://analytics.droracle.ai/): Privacy-friendly, lightweight alternative to Google Analytics with open-source principles and comprehensive website insights
